Book a salmon charter

Frequently asked questions

Do I need a fishing license for a charter?
Yes. California requires a sport fishing license for anyone 16 or older, even on a charter. One-day licenses are available at the shop on the morning of your trip.
What happens if the weather cancels my charter?
You receive a full refund or a free reschedule. We make the go/no-go call by 4 PM the day before your booking based on the NOAA marine forecast.
Is gear included with charter bookings?
Rods, reels, tackle, and bait are all included. Bring warm layers, rubber boots, and a cooler for your catch.
